title: WPSS/1324/2014 of Het Singh Bhandari Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC No. 68 of 2015 (Recall Application)
CLMA No.989 of 2015 (Delay Condonation Application)
In
WPSS No.1324 of 2014
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate, present
for the petitioner.
Mr. R.P. Sharma, learned Brief
Holder, for the State/respondents.
Supplementary affidavit filed by
respondent nos. 2 & 3 is taken on record.
Delay Condonation Application in
filing recall application (CLMA) No.989 of
2015 is allowed. Delay in filing the recall
application is condoned.
Heard the learned counsel for the
parties on recall application (MCC No. 68 of
2015).
The petitioner retired from service as
Panchayat Mantri. He filed present writ
petition claiming certain arrears of revised
pay.
Vide order dated 14.11.2014, this
writ petition was dismissed as infructuous
as the respondents admitted that the
amount has been sent to the Treasury.
However, the recall application has been
filed with the averment that the amount has
not been paid.
Today, a supplementary counter
affidavit has been filed by one Mr. Bhuwan
Chandra Paneru, District Panchayatraj
Officer, Champawat, in which it has clearly
been stated that the claim of the petitioner
has been given. In fact there is a letter to
this effect, (Annexure No. 2 to the
supplementary counter affidavit) by which
the petitioner has accepted the arrears and
now nothing remains with the
State/respondents.
In view thereof, the recall application
(MCC No. 68 of 2015) is dismissed.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 26.02.2015
 ML
